steps.text: 9:33 A.M. \ Foggy
Nameless Barrenlands, Inside Rhodes Island

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Good morning, Closure. Here's your breakfast.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh, thanks!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: There's no mold or anything, right...?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Uh, probably not, I guess.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: *Sigh*... We've been stuck here for days thanks to this shitty weather... Who knows how bad this'll throw off our schedule... Hmm, this flavor...

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: I mean, a Catastrophe caused this thick fog... It's not going to be good if we end up coming head to head with an aftershock.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Should I turn in the environmental Originium monitoring report for last night right now?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Where's Kal'tsit? Is she still in the operating theater?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Yes, she's been there since last night.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Don't worry about it right now, then.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Can I help you with anything else?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hm... Let's see. Wanna finish this health food for me? I mean it. This stuff's got a real funny taste.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Eh?! You want me to eat all that?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Haha, calm down. Just kidding.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: New mail? Out in the wasteland?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Is there a town or a Messenger Outpost close by?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: No... If there was, we would've been in contact with them a couple days ago...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: That's weird. Let's see...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The sender's Dijkstra... What, Dijkstra?! I thought he was in Columbia!

a.text: TO Closure
Dear Closure, it's been a while.
How's things? Going well? The last time we worked together was back in summer, right?
I was really shocked when Grace got in touch with me and told me about your plan. Screwing around with Kazimierz corporate networks isn't exactly small potatoes.
I gotta hand it to you, though. That's exactly your style. Either way, it was a good time, second only to that hit we did in Columbia once! It was perfect!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Acute lesions successfully removed.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Keep the infusion going.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Wound is clean...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Hold on, confirm the patient's vitals.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Okay...!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Doctor! The patient's heart rate is abnormal... Body... body temperature is dropping!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Calm down.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Adjust transmural pressure. I need an injection intervention right now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Prepare to stop the bleeding.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Okay!

a.text: But you know. It doesn't matter how many banks we hack, how many millionaires we screw with. Even if we manage to take control of half the city's drones, put a stop to all the machines, and scare the cowards shitless—
It's all just fleeting, and anything fleeting might as well be pointless.
Before I forget, Closure. There's something I need to tell you.
There was this one time I mentioned a friend of mine who's got Oripathy. Do you remember?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, everyone... It's time to change shift.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Blaze!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Did something happen?

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Nope... Well, given this visibility, the surveillance equipment's about the only thing we can trust.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: I doubt even the sniper operators on lookout can see anything in this weather...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Eh, you're right. All this fog is a major buzzkill...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Stormeye wouldn't have much trouble with the fog. If only he had left just two weeks later. Too bad.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It's been a few days since we stopped, though. If anything's gonna happen, it should already have happened by now.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You guys should head back and get some rest.

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: Yeah, sure.

a.text: That man was as healthy as could be.
He had a decent education and a decent job. He was married, though no kids.
He didn't even know how he caught Oripathy. He just showed up to work one morning to find a posting on the company notice board about his infection. Everyone started looking at him different.
To tell the truth, I was too lazy to look into it all that much. Someone was either jealous, or they were trying set him up, some kind of infighting.
Anyway, after that, his life was ruined. He lost his job, and his wife left him. How can you blame them, though? We all know Oripathy's infectious.

I just met him by chance, and I decided to help him on a whim too. Making a few quick changes to a database here or there isn't much for people like us, you know. A few keystrokes and we change a man's fate. Almost magical, huh?
So, that's what I figured. I thought it was unfair, so I did that for him.
I thought I was helping him.
But things didn't unfold quite like I expected.
He didn't go back to the life he once had.
I met the guy again in the barrenlands outside Columbia. He had joined an Infected organization. He told me his comrades in Ursus needed his help, and that's why he went there.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: An Infected organization...?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hmm... So this guy got caught up with the Infected too?

a.text: Closure, take a guess what I'm trying to tell you with this story.
Eyes.
They went to great lengths to find me, but I still didn't know the slightest thing about the Infected.
They were travel-worn, their equipment was outdated, and most of them were malnourished—
But their eyes were full of light.
Closure, it took us a long time to find this ray of light. A very, very long time.
Anger, unwillingness, the readiness to make sacrifices for a belief, the mind to give your life for a certain cause.
Same as you and your buddies over there. We want to change something. We know what's wrong.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: 'That's why I decided to help them. Columbia, Kazimierz, and the Sarkaz homeland you told me all about—'

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: 'That's what we've always been doing. Always, even—'

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: '—Now.'

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...That's it?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Is that supposed to be it? Hold on, what do you mean, 'Now?'

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Whoa! What just happened?!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The tremor... came from below. It was huge, too—An explosion?!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Ahh! Wh-What's going on?!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: We told everyone ahead of time how difficult this surgery was going to be. We told them we needed absolute silence!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Uh, this is the operating theater... What?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: The security door's been... What?! All the bulkheads are locked? Huh? That's...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Stay calm.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Contact all the operators we can. Tell them to head to confinement immediately.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Also, tell Blaze that she may damage the ship's facilities as necessary.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: R-Right!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Everyone else, continue the operation.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We'll leave what's going on outside to the other operators.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There is nothing more important than the patient's life in the operating room. Don't get distracted.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Ah, I'm truly sorry! I'll get ready right away!

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I thought this would've been more difficult.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: But this must be our first formal meeting, 'Leader' of Reunion.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You are... Reunion.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You don't seem very surprised.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I simply know better than anyone that the fires of Infected fury cannot be extinguished so easily.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's just...

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: —It's been a while, 'Leader.'

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's you...!

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Don't remember me? Ha, of course you don't! I was just a nameless pawn, someone lucky enough to avoid letting you kill me back in Chernobog!

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: But you, Talulah, our 'Leader!' I will never forget your damned face!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You joined us when our team passed through the village that was destroyed by the taxmen. Your name is... Valiya.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: You remember my name, huh...? So, what about Leontyev, Denis, and Arseny? Do you remember them? Do you know what happened to them?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: I'm here because I want to ask you myself: Why did you do what you did?! Who gave you the right?! How could you betray us?!

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Let go of her collar.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Now's not the time. We need to leave this place first.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You heard him, Leader of the Infected.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: We all want answers. Many of us have suffered waiting for this chance. The chance to get them from you.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Don't forget. Those who most deserve to judge you, to hear out your defense, and to determine your fate, are the Infected who rose and died for you.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Talulah, you need to come with us.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Closure! Are you okay?! What was that just now?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What kind of sick joke is this?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Closure?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You've gotta be kidding me! He's definitely somewhere close by. He paralyzed Rhodes Island's systems!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The surveillance... and observation systems... Hah, not bad...

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: I got a transmission from Logistics! Some of the operators have been ambushed by... R-Reunion!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: No way! Reunion?!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: No, no, no—Hurry! Tell Amiya right now. They might be here for Talulah! I'll get these systems back up. We need to act fast!

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Y-Yes, ma'am!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Why am I getting a message now, of all times?!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Argh! My control screen's locked?!

steps.name: Dijkstra
steps.text: Good morning. Good morning?

steps.name: Dijkstra
steps.text: Hard at work fixing your system, Closure? You're kinda mad right now, aren't you?

steps.name: Dijkstra
steps.text: Oh, I should probably mention this video's prerecorded. You don't have to waste time tracing me.

steps.name: Dijkstra
steps.text: Oh, also, I went through the trouble of keeping your Medical Department's system modules separate when I did all the prep work overnight. Spares the innocent, you know? I'm a stand-up guy, aren't I?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Dijkstra—!

steps.name: Dijkstra
steps.text: Sorry about this, Closure. I know it's pretty unchill to nail you with this hookup you so graciously gave me. But still...

steps.name: Dijkstra
steps.text: I'd do it again. You know me. No regrets.

steps.name: Dijkstra
steps.text: When you gave me the prototype back then, you said it was, at the time, the best option for taking down Columbian network programs. You called it your trump card.

steps.name: Dijkstra
steps.text: And doing my wetwork the past couple days, I realized you weren't lying. Rhodes Island's security system works very similar to the logic you handed me.

steps.name: Dijkstra
steps.text: So yeah, I abused your trust, no doubt about that. But you've got your position, I got my judgment. That's how it goes.

steps.name: Dijkstra
steps.text: I still remember how I met you, just a Sarkaz back then, and how we became friends.

steps.name: Dijkstra
steps.text: I hope we're still friends... Or, like before, war buddies.

steps.name: Dijkstra
steps.text: —That said, Closure.

steps.name: Dijkstra
steps.text: First and foremost, I'm a rebel. We've always been rebels. Always will be.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Where do you get off... c'mon, so damned full of yourself!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: No... Now's not the time to worry about this. Is the comm system still working?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: All stations!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Grr, if Ascalon and Logos were here, you wouldn't be running around like you own the place—

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: —Hey! Get out here!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I know you're hiding on both sides of the hallway, but this is Rhodes Island, and you aren't fooling me!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Right, Blaze, this is Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: It was this very same corridor where I first saw you and the other elite operators come home after a triumphant victory.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Guard...?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: I hesitated. When I first learned about the plan to attack Rhodes Island. Of course I hesitated.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: I'm not going to justify it, but I think this is exactly why I have to come back. Both to take responsibility and to bear witness to this plan's execution.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: 'Responsibility...' huh?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Right. If I'm here, I can't make excuses.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: If there's even a single operator who thinks it, then I am indeed a 'traitor.'

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: So you're with Reunion now... what are you doing back here?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: The few survivors who managed to make it out of Ursus drifted out in the borderless barrenlands.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: First we got to Columbia, then Leithanien, and then Siracusa, Victoria... All these countries... there were Infected trying to get in touch with us.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Reunion managed to set a fire, and from the tundra all across the world.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: But... what are we supposed to tell the Infected who chose to stand up for our cause because of Talulah, and to the Infected who chose to stand up against fate because of the Ursus Reunion Movement—

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: How do we break it to them that we failed in Chernobog, and that Reunion was yet another pawn, tossed away by the great powers once it exhausted its usefulness?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: There are way too many Infected left in the dark, Infected who lost friends and loved ones.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: That's why Reunion needs that truth. They need the 'leader' to answer to them.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: And then...

steps.name: Guerrilla Sarkaz
steps.text: Then, we will start all over.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: —Sarkaz?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: No, you're no ordinary mercenaries—

steps.name: Guerrilla Sarkaz
steps.text: Damned straight.

steps.name: Guerrilla Sarkaz
steps.text: I heard that nutjob W started chumming with you guys after that? Well, whatever.

steps.name: Guerrilla Sarkaz
steps.text: After the Captain died, not all of the guerrilla fighters decided to part ways with Reunion...

steps.name: Guerrilla Sarkaz
steps.text: Hand Talulah over. If Reunion still exists, then she belongs to us.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...Hah.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You think we're gonna talk this over and come to a nice agreement?

steps.name: Guerrilla Sarkaz
steps.text: Yeah, that's not gonna happen.

steps.name: Guerrilla Sarkaz
steps.text: Talulah's got Lungmenite and Rhodes Islander blood on her hands, but let's not forget there's blood on your hands too. The Captain's, and Yelena's.

steps.name: Guerrilla Sarkaz
steps.text: Don't you think for a second we'll go easy on you.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Nine, the barriers have been activated. This whole area's sealed off. We just need to deal with the hostiles in here ASAP.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Good. Get the team ready for rendezvous and exfiltration.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Sure thing.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: The enemies are fighting back. We don't have enough manpower—

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: We're not fighting for the sake of fighting here. Prioritize the evacuation!

steps.name: Guard Operator
steps.text: In your dreams! You aren't getting away that easily!

steps.name: Sniper Operator
steps.text: Don't even think about it!

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Ugh, why can't this ever be easy.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Boss, you go on ahead!

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Right. Be sure to catch up. I'll see you later.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Confirm the exfiltration route!

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Confirmed. No trouble at all! We'll make it out of here without a hitch if we keep to the plan!

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Good, contact the team outside. The plan is a go!

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Roger!
Hold it!
—Stop. You are not leaving.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I won't let you through.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Talulah, you should not have left that room.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are these—Reunion? Are they here to rescue you?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: The leader of Rhodes Island herself. Well, the word 'rescue' isn't very appropriate here, not that it matters.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Now I do hope you'll understand. She's coming with us, and she doesn't have a choice.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, she's staying here.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Ursus and Lungmen both have a right to prosecute Talulah, and naturally Rhodes Island has a reason to imprison her.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: But Talulah also owes us an explanation. To Reunion... and to the Infected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: —In that case, why not trust Rhodes Island, and wait until Talulah can give you that explanation?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: That's the same thing Guard said to us, he wanted us to trust you.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: And Ch'en... Lungmen's Superintendent Ch'en once said she wanted to create fair terms by which an Infected like her could be judged.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: But what even counts as fair?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Chernobog and Lungmen have seen so much sacrifice, so much needless death. Even if she had a thousand excuses, she's still guilty.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Rhodes Island is welcome to forge that future, to wait for it to come, but... Reunion, the ones she betrayed... they don't get a say?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Answer me, as Rhodes Island's leader.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In that case, we can wait together.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Shieldguards are willing to believe... and so do Rhodes Island's operators... that there will come a day we give everyone an answer...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, right now, Reunion is trying to snatch her away from Rhodes Island through violence. How is anyone supposed to trust in Reunion?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I don't want the Infected to see any more bloodshed. I don't want to fight the Reunion Movement again. But why must you—

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Even if I'm willing to wait, and there are others who are... 'Reunion' cannot wait.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: That's all I have to say.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Nine! We have to move! We can't waste any more time with her!

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Let's go, Talulah.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wait, you can't—

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: That's not for you to decide!

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Everyone, stop the Cautus! Watch her Arts!

steps.name: Guerrilla Sarkaz
steps.text: You're strong, Rhodes Island Infected! There's no way I could stop you alone!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Heh, I'll take that as a compliment. That mean you're letting me by?

steps.name: Guerrilla Sarkaz
steps.text: No, I was just thinking that at least Yelena gave her life fighting a true warrior!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Aw, too bad. I'm in a hurry, though. So you guys are in for a hard time!

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: —Crossbowman, stop her!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: There's more of you—?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wait—You—? What's that you're holding?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: The captain's crossbow. You've been taking good care of it.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: But as long as we choose to stand up, it's too early for that crossbow to be sealed away as a mere memento of the dead.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: All hands, ready.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: This rabbit... She's so young. How is she this powerful?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: *Pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Out of... the way!

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Heh... I signed up for this ambush ready to sacrifice myself.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Come, Cautus. I saw your battle at the core city. Honestly, I admire you people.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: But I won't give in. Even if the Infected have to die here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: It's flowering season.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A-Are those... flowers? When did—

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You take nonlethal shots, even at a time like this.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You're a worthy leader, Rhodes Island, but it's about time you got some sleep.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (You... can't...)

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Um, can your Arts work a little faster...? I mean, how much time is this going to buy us?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Enough. Have all teams move to our current position. The aircraft will be here—

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Wait! Nine! Dijkstra says he's got something approaching us fast on the camera feed!

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Are there other operators...?

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: No, no! That's not human!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Elated roar)

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: S-Stop that thing! It's after Nine and Talulah—

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Relaxedly stretches its limbs)

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Howls)

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Woah!

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Just what... is that—?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Roars)

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: (Crap! My Arts can't—)

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Taunting roar)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Silence isn't an answer, Reunion.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Now, here's my answer. Not that I am given a choice, as you said.

steps.name: Guerrilla Sarkaz
steps.text: Nine! We don't have the time! We can't hold that Feline and the monster for very long!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Roars)

steps.name: Guerrilla Sarkaz
steps.text: Ugh—Dammit!

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: 30 seconds more...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hngh.... Mmm...?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Agitated roars)

steps.name: Guerrilla Sarkaz
steps.text: It's charging you again, Nine—

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm not going to convince anyone, nor will I force anyone to accept what I think.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But it's not over yet.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I will wait for that day to come. Whether it's the day she spoke of, or the day you did. I will wait for my so-called judgment.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But until then—
Flames rise from her fingertips.
Like a great wall built of fury.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: —(Brief timid moans)!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I will live.
You step in front of Amiya, shielding her.
The suffocatingly high temperature briefly dazes you, though the fire's sparks continue to dance in the air, leaving you two unharmed.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Relax, I made sure the flames went around her.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You still have a long road ahead. I can only hope... nothing will cloud your hearts.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: It's time! Nine! We can't wait any longer!

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Well, then... We'll meet again, Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Take that thing down.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Howls)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A Columbian low-altitude aircraft. They've been waiting for foggy weather.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Set Amiya down on the floor. Quick.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: So that's Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Guard said that if, including Kal'tsit, there were just three elite operators around, our ambush wouldn't have worked.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: That's why today... that was our only chance.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: How long have you been preparing for this?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: A long time.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: So? Where are we going?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Where it all started.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mmgh...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Calm down... She passed out. That's all.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's no mere Arts, though. It might be plant toxins... Blaze.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Take Amiya to Medical.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I can see it on your face. Don't blame yourself. That Sarkaz was no run-of-the-mill fighter.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But I still let them get away.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: If... If only I had gotten more answers out of Guard—!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Guard...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: They came prepared, and we weren't.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: H-Hey, everybody? How's everything—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: A—Amiya...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Let's get a damage report and take care of the wounded first. We'll talk about the rest later.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: That guy played me like a fiddle... This ambush could've been avoided.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Dammit...! I gave him that thing because I trusted him—!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I am listening.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: This ship... Rhodes Island might be finding itself under frequent, direct threats, just like we used to!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I want to hold an emergency meeting right now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We'll be entering Victoria soon...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We don't have many operators at your disposal.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Well then... Doctor.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'll have you assist Closure. That look on her face... it's seldom seen.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: At least you stood up and shielded Amiya in the end.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What's this...?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Your new cuffs.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: They track your position in real time. And if you try to use your Arts again, you aren't going to enjoy it.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Talulah, you are our prisoner.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: When did you join Reunion, Lungmenite?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Every soul who walks this world is fated to die, let alone the Infected, and let alone me.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: That said, the humiliation the Infected have faced and the fury of the enslaved have not been answered for.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: That's why I can't die for nothing.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: When this comes to an end, you will die.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Then let our brethren tear down the banners of the old era and set all injustice and tyranny ablaze. Then, and only then, scatter their ashes on my grave.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But I know, of course, what you and your followers seek first is the truth.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: It's like you and Ch'en were cut from the same cloth.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You know her.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: I do. And not just Superintendent Ch'en. I know Ch'en Hui-chieh. So I can tell you two are alike.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: That's for another time, though.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Sorry, everyone... I made you worry.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Amiya! Are you okay?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I... I couldn't stop Talulah.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Reunion has been tracking our ship under cover of fog and Catastrophe for at least a dozen days, and they had infiltrated our systems long before that... They didn't make their move right away, and instead waited until we were least prepared.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We will get Talulah back, but it's not necessarily a bad thing that Lungmen and Ursus no longer have a reason to keep track of the Rhodes Island landship.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We're getting closer and closer to Victoria, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We are...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: If he managed to take my systems down... then I can trace him too.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: He couldn't wipe all the records in time. There's gotta be some clues he left behind, like an origin terminal, geolocation info, and how he forged everything—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Just watch! I will find them!

options: I wasn't able to do anything for you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's okay...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's strange... Dr. Kal'tsit, Closure, Doctor. I'm getting a weird feeling about this turn of events.

options: What a coincidence. I've been getting a weird feeling too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Maybe... certain things are fated to happen, and we, sooner or later, have to face them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I think...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...this isn't the end.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: —We will meet again, Talulah.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: —I found a Messenger who can help! It's one of my old—

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Chenchen? Are you spaced off?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's just... I'm getting this weird feeling... Whatever.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Hm? Is everyone from Yan that sensitive? Got some kind of sixth sense?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Exactly. We solve cases with nothing but intuition alone.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Eh?! Can you really?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Heh.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Stop being an idiot. Let's go.
It's cold.
This cold wind and snow used to be a familiar sight, yet it all feels so foreign now.
The snow breeze carries with it many tiny grains of rock, pricking away at the Draco's face.
Ursus's tundras are so much harsher and livelier than what she faintly remembers in her fading memories.
It's cold.
How long has it been since I last felt such cold?
A few months? Half a year? A year?
Has it really...
Has it really been so long?

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Like I said, why are we still keeping her alive like she did nothing wrong?!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Nobody wants to see Talulah hanged more than us.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: We've been through it all, over the years, from our beginnings in the tundras all the way to the end in Chernobog... how do you think we stomach her betrayal?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: She used to... She... *sigh*.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: We don't know the whole story of Chernobog... but it's fishy, and we need a more concrete answer.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Why should we even trust her?!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Leave it to Nine.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: The captain wouldn't want to see Infected morale fall to rock bottom either... but Nine is a bit more calm when it comes to this mess.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: Of course she is! She's a Lungmenite who joined us halfway through! She doesn't know what it means to be part of Reunion—

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: —Watch your mouth!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Where did you think our comrades who left for the other countries started their journey?!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: They started from the snowfields beneath your feet and made their way across the world under the watchful eyes of that disgusting traitor!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: Do you think hanging her will solve the whole thing?!

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: I... Sorry.

steps.name: Reunion Warrior
steps.text: I'll... cool off.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: It's the Infected workmen from Londinium. They keep looking for help, trying to build relationships with other Infected.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Victoria... They rose because of you, Talulah. And that's before we even say... you are a Draco.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Just as you said, you don't have the right to die as you please. If all Reunion across the world rose up in arms because of you, then—

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: —Either the resistance thus far has been futile or... we will need some new tinder for our fire to crackle loud again.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: That's why your next destination is Victoria.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: It's more than that, Talulah.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You still want to stay in Ursus?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm looking for someone.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Someone I should've burned to ashes.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: An evil god who calls himself immortal.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: To resist him.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You know how big this country is, don't you? You have only a few months. It's like a needle in a haystack.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: That's enough time.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I will find him.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You've gone quiet again, all of a sudden.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I... remembered something.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Here we are. This is it.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: This place...

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: This used to be Reunion's stronghold.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Of course, I only heard about it from the survivors. I have no idea what it was like back then.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: What about you? Do you remember?
The silent warrior stops in her tracks.
Amid the vast white blanket brought forth by the Ursus winter, the abandoned stronghold is almost entirely covered in snow, leaving not a trace of its former appearance.
Even Talulah finds this strange. It is as though she can see those scenes unfolding before her. She can immediately tell where the campfire used to be.

The walk was difficult, but the team was as hardened as they could have been. The soldiers once gathered here to sing together and warm their ever-starving stomachs with a soup that had only a hint of salt for taste.
And now, where the campfire once burned, there stands solemnly a misshapen stone slab.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: That's...

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: A cenotaph. It's like a monument.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: It was built by the warriors who survived.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: No matter how the living judge you, no matter what the future holds, you must return here first.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You need to question yourself.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Nine, we've scouted the road ahead.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: We'll go around the village to the west. We'll rendezvous with some fighters there.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: We don't have time. Have everyone go on the double. We need to make it back to the stronghold sooner than planned.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: —Is something the matter?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: I will never forget what you said to us in Chernobog, Talulah.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: And I definitely won't forget what you did in the core city. Everything you did, every decision you made, I will have you answer for them.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Don't even think about running away.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: You heard him. You're not safe here.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: We'll meet up with you up ahead, but you don't have much time.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Go.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: See for yourself the sacrifices you trampled and hold them in your heart. Etch them into your brain forever.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Remember them.
The Draco begins to walk in silence. Her footsteps alone remain on the white snowfields. With each step on the thick snow, the mud below is imprinted with her weight.
Talulah walks tall with her back perfectly straight.
Aside from that one winter, when the slowly fading warmth behind her drained her of breath, she has never once slouched her back.
The names etched on the crude cenotaph appear to have been scrubbed often; they are starting to fade.

It feels as though only a brief moment has passed. At the same time, it also feels like an eternity, to the point that the world itself falls still, and that the weight of emotions falling on the mud amidst the snow can only be borne by the land.
From afar, the warrior appears as both a solemn statue and a tree growing in the snowstorm.

Her roots must dig deep into the earth. Her figure can only expose itself above the snow ever so slightly. Beneath the hidden soil, the massive roots trickling out of the Draco continue to expand and steadily take hold.
At this moment, even the silence itself is engulfed by the snowstorm.
The warrior raises her head. A snowflake flutters downward onto her cheek, dried up before it can dissolve.
The snow ended long ago, in actuality. It's hard to believe that the northern wind granted her this bit of kindness, with the clouds dispersed and the sun shining down brightly.
The weather is fine today. A rare occurrence here in the tundra.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's cold.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Looks like I need to get used to this weather all by myself again.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Sorry, I can't take too long. I need to go now. There are many to whom I owe an explanation.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: One day, we will make it through this snowstorm and reach that end we must ultimately reach...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: But, right now, it looks like this place needs a flame to awaken it.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: —I'd better hurry and start a fire.
